arguments.message: Yes – you can view the delivery attempts in the Delivery log. In the Meridian dashboard go to Settings → Developer → Webhooks → Delivery log. That page shows every request Meridian made to your endpoint, the HTTP status returned, and the response body, regardless of what your own system logged. It also records test events so you can confirm the endpoint is responding with a 2xx before you enable production traffic.
